data.gender_notes: Reamonn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Irish name Raithimin, derived from the Celtic elements rath, meaning 'fort' or 'ruler', and mon, meaning 'monk' or 'little servant'. This name was borne by several early Irish and Scottish saints. The name Reamonn carries the meaning “Strong, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Reamonn usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
